description: Returns NFL depth charts as of the daily nflverse refresh (as_of), for one team or all 32, optionally one position or group (CB, LB, EDGE, ...) or starters only. Each entry has the player, ids, position, formation, slot, depth within the slot (1 = starter), a starter flag, and the player's current injury_status and available, so an OUT or IR starter is flagged rather than moved. Use it for "who are the Bears' starting WRs?" or the next man up behind an injured player. Built from ESPN's public depth charts via nflverse, not official team depth charts. Pro plan (Free and Basic keys get 403 pro_required).

position.description: Depth chart position, e.g. QB, RB, WR, TE, LT, C, PK, LCB, WLB. Groups also work: K, OT, G, OL, and on defense DE, DT, DL, EDGE, LB, CB, S, DB.
position.title: Position

starters.description: true = starters only: the first player in each slot (depth 1), e.g. three WRs per team in the base offense. With position=QB, every team's starting QB.
starters.title: Starters

team.description: Only this team. Default: all 32. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.
team.title: Team

name: get_depth_chart

as_of.description: The nflverse snapshot time the depth charts come from.

entries.description: Per entry: team, player, player_id, espn_id, gsis_id, position, formation, slot, depth (order within the slot, 1 = starter), starter, rank (the source's position-wide rank, not a starter flag), and injury_status and available from GridIron's injury data (null when the player isn't in /players, e.g. most defenders).

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

source.description: Attribution: nflverse, CC-BY-4.0, built from ESPN's public depth charts.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

title: NFL depth charts and starters
